cases.script:
# Rank118 separate complete-stock, warm acidic oxalate control
add v1 water 100mL @ 60C
seal v1 1L
inspect v1
add v1 H2SO4 0.01mol @ 60C
add v1 H2C2O4 0.005mol @ 60C
add v1 KMnO4 0.002mol @ 60C
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1

forecast.principal: Acidic warm complete stocks support the curated permanganate/oxalic-acid conversion, consuming2mmol permanganate and forming10mmolCO2.

checks.quantity: retained KMnO4 plus MnO4- after reaction
retained carbon increment over sealed baseline
final pH in explicitly acidic domain

unearned_claims_excluded: No empirical rate, initiation threshold, calibrated heat or yield claim. The curated model itself still lacks acid/temperature gating.
No alias for C2O4-- and no replacement of original first failure.
Unmodeled oxalate acid speciation or any unexpected phase/charge boundary must be retained and assessed, not ignored.

changes_from_original: Use molecular oxalic acid and potassium permanganate as complete stocks.
Use excess0.01mol sulfuric acid; original16mmol bareH+ is not treated as a physical stock.
Explicit60C dispenses instead of25C; preparation changed prospectively, not a replay of the original.
Retain100mL water and1L finite sealed headspace.

motivating_previous_followup: prepared-basis-first2 rank118 retained uncompensated analytical charge and excluded Rhodochrosite phase limits. These original results remain immutable.
execution_policy: Exactly one request for this separately frozen changed-stock/temperature script; no ambiguous retry.
qualification: Prepared physical-stock followup with prospective checks, not empirical calibration or closure of the original ion-identity gap.
